selector_freeze_rule: freeze at zero budget or after budget exhaustion
query_rule: diagnostic fixed uniform label-blind query positions; action 2 forced at scheduled positions; policy/random controls only routes elsewhere
reward_reference: online: previous queried samples only, excluding feature-identical current; train: independent training batch excluding feature-identical current; per-example positive gain and damage; no reference gradient
action_mask: query disabled at exhausted budget in behavior and DDQN next-action maximization
state_protocol: features; frozen probabilities; context probabilities; optional four previous-paid pre-feedback route EMA statistics; remaining-budget fraction; elapsed-stream fraction
selector_target: DDQN gamma=0.95; next sample transitions; terminal at budget exhaustion or stream end
routing_reward: pre-feedback routed correctness +1/-1; query adds transfer gain minus damage minus cost
online_reward_access: queried labels only; skip-route counterfactuals use the same paid label; no unqueried correctness reward

forgetting.protocol: observer only; reference is source validation partition; no gradient or reward use; final target score retrospective

routing_oracle.protocol: true-label observer; exact per-sample accuracy ceiling over pre-feedback frozen/Context routes along unchanged policy update trajectory; not an oracle query policy or global adaptation optimum

router_online_protocol: paid pre-feedback route preferences only; replay 256, minibatch 32, reset per level; one update per paid label after first preference
router_exploration_protocol: epsilon random route 0/1 on non-query rows; fixed uniform query schedule
